office_does: The county auditor records deeds and documents, keeps the county's accounts and, in Columbia County, also runs budgeting, licensing and elections.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Will Hutchens, in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Columbia County Auditor since 2023, a farm office manager and volunteer firefighter, running unopposed with no party preference.
highlights: Auditor 2023-2026; leads the office's budgeting, finance, licensing, recording and elections staff [S1]
Oversaw the county's part of the 2024 statewide hand recount: 1,349 ballots, no changes [S6]
M.I.M., Portland State; B.S. in crop science, WSU [S1]
